details:
After having tried out the Beta, I did start to love the new Icon feature with the new nameplates. It's very slick. Cutting to the chase, I feel user Icons should be used for user images in the Social Menu.
 
Currently Icons are planned only for paying VRC+ users. It seems this leaves a lot on the table that could really benefit many users while still boosting the desirability of VRC+. 

My suggestion to make this work would be to grant free users only a single Icon at a time, and only allow them to use the in game Icon capture method. Giving everyone a single in game Icon would allow that Icon to be used for the Social Menu. 

VRC+ Users would get the ability to have the full Icon limit, and gain the ability to upload custom Icons from the computer. This would result in a much more personal and meaningful experience for the bulk of the players. I've already begun making 256x256 images in photoshop specifically for Icons to display things like "BRB" "I'm Mute" "zzzz" and simple things, that's way cool and enough of a reason to push me to VRC+.

Currently the Social Menu simply shows users current/last avatar worn. Sometimes this is an avatar that users don't want other users seeing them in, or they're wearing an avatar for a specific moment, world, or what have you and it's not desirable to show every one on your friends list that you are wearing that avatar, or wore it recently. Many times I've had to change avatars before I log off simply because I don't want a certain avatar shown in Social and it's always an annoyance when I log out with something stupid on. I've also caught myself, and my friends, not wanting to even try on specific avatars because it would show it in Social.

Allowing users to specifically set an Icon gives much more personality to the appearance of users and benefits the community as a whole while improving user engagement. This could also help users locate their friends in large lists easier, or make it easier to identify someone who recently changed their name if they keep the same, or similar style of Icon. This could also help those who feel left behind, or who feel as though updates are/will be paywalled while not really impacting the usefulness of VRC+ to users who wish to upload custom Icons, or have a nice list of Icons to swap between at their leisure. 

While I understand that a UI revision is most likely in the works, and this sort of change may not be manageable or desirable from a development stand point. I feel it would be a very useful, and worthwhile change to the game.  A change of this sort would not impact the profitability of VRC+, would help limit the divide in the community, and would vastly improve the general user experience.
title: [1019] User Icons in Social Menu
